def factor_smooth_dual_momentum_volume(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    fast_mom = close.pct_change(5)
    slow_mom = close.pct_change(20)
    slow_weight = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.tanh(slow_mom * 2)
    combined = fast_mom * (0.5 + slow_weight)
    vol_ma20 = volume.rolling(20).mean()
    vol_ratio = volume / vol_ma20.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_weight = np.clip(vol_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)
    df_copy["factor_smooth_dual_momentum_volume"] = combined * vol_weight
    return df_copy["factor_smooth_dual_momentum_volume"]
description: Combines fast and slow momentum using a smooth nonlinear gating (tanh) to capture directional persistence and multi-day momentum strength. When the 20-day trend is positive, the 5-day momentum is amplified; when negative, it is dampened. The smooth transition avoids sharp regime switches, preserving cross-sectional variation while allowing nonlinear interaction. Volume confirmation ensures participation.
